ohtani.title: Marte, E-Rod support D-backs' 4-2 win over Dodgers
ohtani.blurb: Ketel Marte hits a two-run home run while Eduardo Rodriguez strikes out nine across seven solid innings in the D-backs' 4-2 win vs. Dodgers

imanaga.title: PCA shines in MVP showdown to lead Cubs past Dodgers
imanaga.blurb: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits two home runs and drives in four runs to lead the Cubs to a win over the Dodgers in an MVP caliber performance

suzuki.title: Jac Caglianone hits two home runs in Royals' win
suzuki.blurb: Jac Caglianone hits two home runs and Seth Lugo strikes out five in the Royals' 6-3 win over the Cubs

yoshida.title: Tolle's 14 K's lift Red Sox to ninth straight win
yoshida.blurb: Payton Tolle sets a new career high with 14 strikeouts, powering the Red Sox to a 13-1 win over the Athletics

okamoto.title: Kyle Schwarber crushes two home runs in walk-off win
okamoto.blurb: Kyle Schwarber slugs two home runs and Derek Hill delivers a walk-off single in the Phillies' 7-6 win over the Blue Jays

murakami.title: Colson Montgomery's home run leads White Sox in win
murakami.blurb: Colson Montgomery hits a three-run home run and the bullpen limits the Guardians to just one run in the White Sox 5-3 win

matsui.title: Smith, Paredes lead Astros to 6-3 win
matsui.blurb: Two home runs from Cam Smith and a three-hit day from Isaac Paredes lead the Astros to a 6-3 win over the Padres
